Privacy Policy

PRIVACY POLICY

Protecting your privacy is very important to us at Coach Masters Academy ( CMA ) Global. Privacy is an important issue and CMA takes it seriously to safeguard your information you may provide via our website.

This Privacy Policy is applicable to our registered users and visitors to the Site.

  • Your personal information will never be sold to any third-parties.
  • We typically do not collect personal information but in case we do, those will be done by lawful and fair means and, where appropriate, with the knowledge or consent of the individual concerned.
  • Our website does not track visitors and any information collected will be data provided by the visitor with full knowledge of why they are providing the information.
  • We will obtain the consent of the individual, we will collect and use personal information solely for fulfilling those purposes specified by us and for other ancillary purposes.
  • We will use reasonable security safeguards to protect personal information against loss or theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.
  • We will be open and transparent with the individual and provide information about our policies and practices relating to the management of personal information.
  • We will retain personal information for the fulfillment of those purposes, for as long as necessary for that purpose.

Acceptance of these terms

This Privacy Policy is incorporated into and subject to the terms of the CMA.

This Privacy Policy applies only to information submitted and collected online through the Site and does not apply to information that may be collected by CMA through any other website, including through any social media site or offline. We would request you not to provide us with any information, in case you do not agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. By voluntarily providing your personally identifiable information on the Site, you are providing consent to the collection and use of such personally identifiable information as per this Privacy Policy. We might revise this Privacy Policy from time to time. Please visit this page to get updates on our policy.

Information we collect from you

You may be providing us with your name, email address, company name, business type, or other interest at the time of communication or what so ever, will be kept highly confidential and will be used for a legitimate business purpose only. CMA will not share, distribute or reference any personal information with third parties except as otherwise set forth in this Privacy Policy..

CMA uses third party services to process the data, and these might include Mailchimp, WordPress, Twitter and Linkedin, Zoom and survey monkey. For these providers, we recommend that you read their privacy policies so you can understand the manner in which your personal information will be handled by these providers.
In particular, remember that certain providers may be located in or have facilities that are located a different jurisdiction than either you or us. So if you elect to proceed with a transaction that involves the services of a third-party service provider, then your information may become subject to the laws of the jurisdiction(s) in which that service provider or its facilities are located. Once you leave our website or are redirected to a third-party website or application, you are no longer governed by this Privacy Policy or our website’s Terms of Service.

Using Your Information

Using your information When you fill out any form on our website or register with CMA, we may email you with the information regarding our services and other programs.

Stop getting emails/unsubscribe/right to be forgotten

You can unsubscribe your self from receiving our emails just by opting on the unsubscribe button in our email received from us or contacting us at maiya@coachmastersacademy.com

Third Party Websites and Applications

Sometimes we might provide links to third party websites. CMA does not control and is not responsible for the third party websites or for the privacy policies or information practices of third parties or their websites. Moreover, CMA does not have access to or control of the cookies that may be placed by such third parties.

Data Protection

CMA has made reasonable efforts to ensure the security of our system as security is important for both. In addition, if you suspect unauthorized access to your information, it is your responsibility to contact CMA immediately. Please be aware that Internet data transmission is not always secure and we cannot warrant that information you transmit utilizing the Site is secure.
  • We might store your data until you either requests deletion or performs the delete yourself.
  • First and Last Name: Identifying our customers.
  • Email Address: Your email is the main communication channel between you and CMA

Questions / Feedback
